meta.name: relational-database-mcp-cloudbase
meta.description: [Deprecated] This is the required documentation for agents operating on the CloudBase Relational Database through MCP. It defines the canonical SQL management flow with `queryMysqlDatabase`, `manageMysqlDatabase`, `queryPermissions`, and `managePermissions`, including MySQL provisioning, destroy flow, async status checks, safe query execution, schema initialization, and permission updates. New environments should use PostgreSQL — see postgresql-development skill instead.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 MCP 工具管理 CloudBase 关系型数据库（MySQL），包括查询数据、创建/销毁实例、执行 SQL 语句、初始化表结构以及调整权限。
howto.when: 当用户要求检查或查询 SQL 数据、创建或销毁 MySQL、修改数据或结构、初始化表或管理权限时触发。

say.text: 帮我查询用户表的前50条记录。
创建一个新的 MySQL 数据库实例。
给订单表设置只读权限。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can manage CloudBase relational databases (MySQL) via MCP tools: query data, provision/destroy instances, execute SQL, initialize schemas, and update permissions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to inspect or query SQL data, create or destroy MySQL, modify data or schema, initialize tables, or manage permissions.

say_en.text: Query the top 50 records from the users table.
say_en.note: Claude will use queryMysqlDatabase to run SELECT and return results.

say_en.text: Create a new MySQL database instance.
say_en.note: Claude will call manageMysqlDatabase to provision and wait for readiness.

say_en.text: Set read-only permission on the orders table.
say_en.note: Claude will use managePermissions to update the permission config.
